template.name: Ichimoku Implied Volatility
template.entry_long: crossabove(close, sma((high+low)/{p0},{p0})) and sma((high+low)/{p1},{p1}) > sma((high+low)/2,{p2}) and close > sma(close,52)
template.notes: The docs defer entry conditions to the implementation, so the Ichimoku structure is rebuilt from the documented periods: Tenkan 9 and Kijun 26 as mid-point SMAs, SenkouSpanB 52 as the cloud reference, and IVPeriod 20 implied-volatility context is not expressible as a gate. The ATR-multiple and Tenkan/Kijun-derived stops have no fixed percentage values, so both percentage fields are null.
